WITH oos AS (
  SELECT date FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND units_sold = 0
)
SELECT o.date,
       f.forecast_units_per_day,
       d.units_sold,
       ROUND((f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold)::numeric,2) AS lost_units,
       ROUND((f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold) * p.price_inr,2) AS lost_inr,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines pl
         WHERE pl.bill_ts::date = o.date AND pl.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) AS bills_with_other_atta,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines pl WHERE pl.bill_ts::date = o.date) AS all_bills_that_day,
       (SELECT string_agg(s.status,',') FROM store.shelf_audits s
         WHERE s.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND s.audit_ts::date = o.date) AS audit_status
FROM oos o
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date=o.date
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date=o.date
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY o.date;

SELECT pl.bill_ts::date AS d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) AS bills_with_other_atta,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-1KG') AS bills_1kg,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-10KG') AS bills_10kg,
       SUM(pl.qty) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-1KG') AS units_1kg,
       SUM(pl.qty) FILTER (WHERE pl.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-10KG') AS units_10kg
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.bill_ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-12', DATE '2026-06-24', DATE '2026-06-25', DATE '2026-06-26')
  AND pl.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH june AS (
  SELECT * FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
),
oos AS (
  SELECT j.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, j.units_sold, p.price_inr
  FROM june j
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=j.sku AND f.date=j.date
  JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=j.sku
  WHERE j.units_sold = 0
),
audit AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS audits,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
),
proxy AS (
  SELECT o.date,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines pl
            WHERE pl.bill_ts::date=o.date AND pl.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) AS bills_other_atta,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines pl
            WHERE pl.bill_ts::date=o.date) AS bills_total
  FROM oos o
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM june) AS bags_sold,
       (SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) FROM june) AS revenue_inr,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oos) AS oos_days,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold),2) FROM oos) AS lost_units,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM((forecast_units_per_day - units_sold) * price_inr),2) FROM oos) AS lost_value_inr,
       (SELECT SUM(bills_other_atta) FROM proxy) AS proxy_bills_other_atta,
       (SELECT SUM(bills_total) FROM proxy) AS all_bills_on_oos_days,
       (SELECT audits FROM audit) AS audits,
       (SELECT on_shelf FROM audit) AS on_shelf,
       (SELECT empty FROM audit) AS empty,
       (SELECT ROUND(100.0*on_shelf/NULLIF(audits,0),1) FROM audit) AS osa_pct;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
     WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
       AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_lines_units,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines
     WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
       AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_lines_bills,
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
     WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
     WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS audits,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
     WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='on shelf'
       AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
     WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='empty'
       AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS empty;

SELECT pl.bill_ts::date AS d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) AS bills_with_other_atta,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pp.bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments pp
         WHERE pp.ts::date = pl.bill_ts::date) AS all_paid_bills_that_day
FROM store.pos_lines pl
WHERE pl.bill_ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-12', DATE '2026-06-24', DATE '2026-06-25', DATE '2026-06-26')
  AND pl.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
